message: パンと魔王

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah, Misa, you know more about policy books and organizational theory than romance novels, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-What?! Hold on, Sakura-kun, just what kind of girl do you take me for in your head?」

name: Misa
message: 「Where in the world would you find a schoolgirl who loves reading books like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, look, you're always supporting me in the Student Council, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「You organize related agenda items so well, and thanks to you, notices to each department get the key points across concisely.」

name: Synn
message: 「Policy books aside, that's amazing stuff you can't just pull off overnight, right? So I figured you must be studying really hard.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean? Anyone who takes pride in being a Student Council officer can do that much naturally.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How admirable of you, Madam Vice President~」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Though there are exceptions...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~, there seems to be a lot of depth to this.」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Lolotte-dono...」

name: Misa
message: 「So, jokes aside, if you're being serious, how do I look to you, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, stories about sellswords... I mean! Probably fantasies about a gallant maiden swordswoman and the beautiful girl mage who assists her.」

name: Shio
message: 「Close! Wrong genre, Synn-dono.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, I have read things like that, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「After defeating the Demon Lord in another world ruled by night, the big-sister hero and her little-sister mage greet the morning and set off on a new journey... *sigh*」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp! D-Demon Lord...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A journey of morning rise, huh? How dreamy.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Y-You mustn't leave it at just dreaming, Lolotte-san. With us, we can make it a reality.」

name: Misa
message: 「We just need to join forces with Onee-sama and exterminate the demons trying to take advantage of Re-Crea to do evil.」

name: Misa
message: 「And if we defeat the Demon Lord at the very end, there couldn't be a more wonderful happy ending than that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, the Demon Lord is the king of the Demon World. He must surely be an utter villain.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to steam a bread roll for the Demon Lord.」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, in the church, breaking bread together is proof of family...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm so glad! Lolotte, I knew an angel like you would understand!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I misspoke. I'm going to beat the Demon Lord to a pulp.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!! Also, I am not an angel!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, what's wrong? You have a look of sheer anguish on your face?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you guys treating the Demon Lord like a villain just based on how the title sounds? If you actually got to know him, maybe the Demon Lord wouldn't be such a terrible guy?」

name: Misa
message: 「I like to think I've read quite a few books, and I've never heard of a Demon Lord like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I have!!」
I came up to the hilltop plaza alone for a change of pace.

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is here too, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't count, Paqy, since you already know everything about me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Saying it like that makes it sound weird, ya know. I'm blushing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah~」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's one deep sigh, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「...H-Huh? Even when you call me Demon Lord, Paqy, it doesn't really get me down?」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it... So what I actually hate is the Demon Lord being misunderstood, and having to hide my true identity from everyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're just realizing that now?」

name: Synn
message: 「I had a vague feeling, sure, I just didn't want to admit it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa in particular burns with hostility toward the Demon Lord, right? I just can't bring myself to come clean.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though I'd like to follow her example when it comes to her single-minded dedication to her goal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're worrying way too much. It's not like you've actually done anything bad, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm continuing to deceive my comrades.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why not just keep quiet about it? At worst, you'll just mope around a bit, Demon Lord--nobody else gets hurt.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine for now, but who knows what'll happen down the road...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nobody's gonna know something like that, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, if you told Hisu right now, your position as Demon Lord would definitely get real dicey.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so too?」

name: Paqy
message: 「A white lie's justified sometimes. Just suck it up!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahahaha, that's rich coming from you, Paqy, when you're always on the verge of spilling the beans.」
Thanks to Paqy, I managed to laugh a little.
...Alright! Time to switch gears and head back to everyone!
